name: Tarjimly (acquired)
long_description: Tarjimly is a YC-backed nonprofit (YC W18) building language-access infrastructure for navigating critical life moments across healthcare, legal, and social services. The company was acquired by CLEAR Global in 2025.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: I lead product for multiple data and AI teams at Monarch, a consumer personal finance platform. Previously, I founded and led Tarjimly, a YC-backed startup building language-access AI and human-in-the-loop software used in high-stakes environments across healthcare, legal, and social services. I scaled the organization to a 20-person team supporting millions of global users and enterprise partners, leading product, hiring, and execution end-to-end through its acquisition in 2025.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder at Nash. Prior to Nash, I spent a couple of years building Tarjimly (YC W18), a mobile application to connect refugees with real, volunteer translators all over the world. Before that, I was a software engineer at Palantir working on a number of high-volume data problems. I received my Bachelors and Masters in Computer Science in 2015 from MIT.

I love mission-driven work that is coupled with great technical execution. I am in the Bay Area, and love meeting new people, so say hello :)
